subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “this subject made students understand that copying can happen beyond pictures and words.”?
options: Even a tone, a pause, or a laugh may belong to someone.
It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.
Looking for facts before blaming someone can save a lot of anger.
It can begin when someone notices a small waste and says something.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The AI voice made students understand that copying can happen beyond pictures and words. Even a tone, a pause, or a laugh…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Looking for facts before blaming someone can save a lot of anger.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The AI voice made students understand that copying can happen beyond pictures and words. Even a tone, a pause, or a laugh may belong…」，答案為「Even a tone, a pause, or a laugh may belong to someone.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Even a tone, a pause, or a laugh may belong to someone.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
